scenario: No interval ordering operators per LINT.5.3. `<`, `>`, `<=`, `>=` are not defined on intervals; intervals do not admit a canonical total order. Authors needing to order intervals write `a.start < b.start`. Pin: `i1 < i2` for two intervals rejects with DS_VALIDATE_INTERVAL_NO_ORDERING.
rules_ds:
schema Pair scope logical:
    entity_id: String key
    a_start: Time mutable
    a_end: Time mutable
    b_start: Time mutable
    b_end: Time mutable

rule trig:
    Pair p where (p.a_start .. p.a_end) < (p.b_start .. p.b_end)
->
    log info "x"
